questions.question: A train is to cover 370 km at a uniform speed. After running 100 km, the train could run at a speed 5 km/h less than its normal speed due to some technical fault. The train got delayed by 36 minutes. What is the normal speed of the train, in km/h?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance covered by the train = 370 km 

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of the train = x km/h

As per the question;

[100/x + 270/(x - 5)] - 370/x = 36/60 

⇒270/(x - 5) - 270/x = 3/5

⇒ 1/(x - 5) - 1/x = 1/450

⇒ [x - (x - 5)]/(x - 5)x = 1/450

⇒ 5/(x - 5)x = 1/450

⇒ 5 × 450 = x² - 5x 

⇒ x2 - 5x - 2250 = 0

⇒x2 - 50x + 45x - 2250 = 0 

⇒ x(x - 50) + 45(x - 50) = 0

⇒ (x + 45)(x - 50) = 0

⇒ x ≠ 45, x = 50

**∴ The required speed of the train = 50 km/h**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**By Hit and Trial Method:

[100/x + 270/(x - 5)] - 370/x = 36/60

Option 1: [100/40 + 270/(35)] - 370/40 ≠ 36/60

Option 2: [100/45 + 270/(40)] - 370/45 ≠ 36/60

**Option 3: [100/50 + 270/(45)] - 370/50 = 36/60**

Option 4: [100/48 + 270/(43)] - 370/48 ≠ 36/60

questions.solution:
**Given:**

Quantity of rice = 640 kg 

Overall profit percent = 15% 

**Calculation:**

Let the part sold at 5% loss be = a kg

a × - 5% + (640 - a) × 20% = 640 × 15/100 

⇒ - 5a + 640 × 20 - 20a = 640 × 15

⇒ 640 × 20 - 640 × 15 = 25a 

⇒ 640 × (20 -15)/25 = a 

⇒ a = 128 

**∴ The part that was sold at 5% loss is 128 kg.**

questions.question: The area of a circular park is 12474 m². There is 3.5 m wide path around the park. What is the area (in m²) of the path? (Take π = (22)/(7))
questions.solution:
**Given:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d1692d64b14a04b58938894359414e3570fae3f1c62712e3db11b4218d1fb6e.png] 

Area of a circular park = 12474 m2

Width of the path = 3.5 m 

**Formulas used:**

Area of circle = πr²

Area of the path = Area of the park with path - Area of the park 

**Calculation:**

Area of the park = 12474 m2

⇒ πr2 = 12474

⇒ r² = 12474 × 7/22 = 81 × 49

⇒ r = 63 m

New radius with the width of the park = R = 63 m + 3.5 m = 66.5 m 

∴ Area of the path = πR2 - πr2

⇒ 22/7 × 66.5 × 66.5 - 12474

⇒ 13898.5 - 12474 

**⇒ 1424.5 m2**

questions.question: If x⁴+(1)/(x⁴) = 727,x>1, then what is the value of (x-(1)/(x))?
questions.solution:

 x⁴+(1)/(x⁴) = 727,x>1

**Formulas used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

(a - b)² = a2 + b2 - 2ab

**Calculation:**

 x⁴+(1)/(x⁴) = 727 

By adding 2 on both sides 

x⁴ + 1/x⁴ + 2 = 727 + 2 

⇒ (x² + 1/x²)² = 729

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2) = √729 

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2) = 27

By subtracting 2 from both sides

⇒ (x2 + 1/x2) - 2 = 27 - 2

⇒ (x - 1/x)² = 25

⇒ (x - 1/x) = √25

**∴ (x - 1/x) = 5**

questions.question: The average of eleven numbers is 56. The average of first three numbers is 52 and that of next five numbers is 60. The 9th and 10th number are 3 and 1 more than the 11th number respectively. What is the average of 9th and 11th numbers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net deviation from the overall average (56) = 3 × (52 − 56) + 5 × (60 − 56) = −12 + 20 = +8.

To balance the average, the deviation of the last 3 numbers must be −8. Thus, their total sum = 3 × 56 − 8 = 160.

Let the 11th number be x. Then, 9th number = x + 3 and 10th number = x + 1.

Sum = x + 3 + x + 1 + x = 160 ⇒ 3x = 156 ⇒ x = 52.

The average of the 9th and 11th numbers = (x + 3 + x) ÷ 2 = x + 1.5 = 52 + 1.5 = 53.5.

**∴ The correct answer is 53.5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Average of first 3 numbers = 52

questions.question: A man and a woman, working together can do a work in 66 days. The ratio of their working efficiencies is 3 ∶ 2. In how many days 6 men and 2 women together can do the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by 1 man and 1 woman = 66 days

Ratio of the efficiency of man and woman = 3 : 2

**Formula used:**

Total work = Time × Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Total work = 66 × (3 + 2) = 66 × 5

∴ Time taken by 6 men and 2 women to do the same job = (66 × 5)/(6 × 3 + 2 × 2)

⇒ (66 × 5)/22 

**⇒ 15 days **

questions.question: Two equal sums were lent on simple interest at 6% and 10% per annum respectively. The first sum was recovered two years later than the second sum and the amount in each case was Rs.1105. What was the sum (in Rs.) lent in each scheme?
questions.solution:
**Formulas used:**

Simple Interest = P × r × t/100 

Amount = Simple Interest + Principal

**Calculation:**

Let year be t and principal be P

As per the question;

(t + 2) × 6% = t × 10%

⇒ 6% t + 12% = 10% t 

⇒ 12% = 4% t 

⇒ t = 3

Amount = Principal + Simple Interest 

⇒ P + P × 6/100 × 5 = 1105

⇒ P + 3/10 × P = 1105

⇒ 13P/10 = 1105

⇒ P = 1105 × 10/13

**∴ P = Rs.850**

questions.question: Find the greatest value of b so that 30a68b (a > b) is divisible by 11.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

30a68b (a > b) is divisible by 11

**Concept:**

If the difference between the sum of the digits at the odd and even places equal 0 or divisible by 11, the number is divisible by 11.

**Calculation:**

(3 + a + 8) - (0 + 6 + b) = 0 or 11

⇒ 11 + a - 6 - b = 0 or 11

⇒ 5 + a - b = 0 or 11

⇒ 5 + a - b ≠ 0 [a > b]

Let 5 + a - b = 11 

⇒ a - b = 6 

⇒ For a = 9, b = 3 ∵ [a > b]

⇒ 9 - 3 = 6

**∴ The greatest value of b is 3, when 30a68b (a > b) is divisible by 11.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] __Mistake Points__**Don't get confused about the value of **'b'.**

We need to look at the 'boundary condition' given in the question i.e. **a > b**

Thus, b cannot be more than a.
